title: DevOps Evangelist
jobDescription: Seeking a Dev Ops Evangelist Who Can Code, Analyze, and Inspire Are you the rare breed who can debug a CI/CD pipeline in the morning and present ROI metrics to the C-suite in the afternoon? ‍ We’re looking for a Dev Ops Evangelist who doesn’t just talk about transformation. They architect it, measure it, and tell compelling stories about its impact. The Ideal Candidate Masterfully Combines: Hands-On Technical Excellence Deep expertise in Dev Ops toolchains and software delivery intelligence platforms Hands-on experience building POVs and technical demonstrations Can roll up sleeves to configure, troubleshoot, and optimize real-world implementations Not afraid to dive into code, infrastructure, and complex integrations Data-Driven Insights Advanced analytical skills in DORA metrics and Developer Experience (Dev Ex) measurement Proven ability to quantify business value and demonstrate ROI from Dev Ops initiatives Expert in measuring the impact of AI coding assistants and Git Hub Copilot on delivery velocity Translates complex metrics into actionable business intelligence Executive-Level Communication Master storyteller who can transform technical achievements into business narratives Designs and delivers training sessions that resonate with executives and technical teams alike Creates compelling presentations that connect Dev Ops metrics to business outcomes Turns data points into strategic insights that drive decision-making The Evangelist Edge Builds proof-of-concepts that showcase transformational value Connects technical capabilities to market opportunities Influences both internal teams and external stakeholders Champions innovation while maintaining practical focus on results What You’ll Do: Transform how organizations think about software delivery by combining hands-on technical work with strategic storytelling. You’ll build compelling demos, analyze delivery intelligence data, and present findings that drive executive buy-in for Dev Ops transformation initiatives. From crafting technical POVs that demonstrate AI-assisted development impact to delivering boardroom presentations on DORA metrics, you’ll be the bridge between what’s technically possible and what’s strategically valuable. ‍ Ready to evangelize the future of software delivery while building it with your own hands?
